What shapes our belief in a machine's potential for consciousness? Here, we will share the evolving results of the Alpha Auriga survey.

As responses come in, we will continuously analyze the data to uncover insights into how factors like age, education, and profession correlate with views on AI. This page will be updated with key statistical findings and data visualizations as soon as our dataset is robust enough for analysis.

Check back soon to see what we've discovered, and if you haven't already, please consider [adding your perspective to our research](survey.qmd#question-consciousness).

```{python}
#| echo: false

import altair as alt
import os
import pandas as pd
import re
from firestore_utils import client
```

```{python}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Load data (optionally filtered by client.tag)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# E.g. CLIENT_TAG=test → only demo data
TAG_FILTER = os.getenv("CLIENT_TAG")

survey_submissions = []
for snap in client().collection("surveySubmissions").stream():
    survey_submission = snap.to_dict()
    tag = survey_submission.get("client", {}).get("tag")
    if (not TAG_FILTER and not tag) or (TAG_FILTER and tag == TAG_FILTER):
        survey_submissions.append(survey_submission)

survey_submissions_df = pd.json_normalize(survey_submissions)
if survey_submissions_df.empty:
    raise ValueError("No records found (TAG filter?)")

# CamelCase → snake_case
def camel_to_snake(name: str) -> str:
    """aiCanBeConscious → ai_can_be_conscious"""
    s1 = re.sub(r"(.)([A-Z][a-z]+)", r"\1_\2", name)
    return re.sub(r"([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", r"\1_\2", s1).lower()

survey_submissions_df.rename(columns={c: camel_to_snake(c) for c in survey_submissions_df.columns}, inplace=True)

survey_submissions_df["server.date"] = pd.to_datetime(survey_submissions_df["server.date"], errors="coerce")

# Derived helper columns
survey_submissions_df["age_band"] = pd.cut(
    survey_submissions_df["age"],
    bins=[0, 18, 30, 45, 60, 120],
    labels=["≤18", "19–30", "31–45", "46–60", "60+"],
    right=False,
)

n_total = len(survey_submissions_df)
```

# Distribution of the main question

## …overall distribution of answers

```{python}
chart_total = (
    alt.Chart(survey_submissions_df)
      .mark_bar()
      .encode(
          x = alt.X(
              "count():Q",
              title = "Count",
              scale = alt.Scale(domain=[0, n_total])    # same max as other charts
          ),
          y = alt.Y(
              "ai_can_be_conscious:N",
              title = "Answer",
              sort = ["yes_already", "yes_future", "only_bio", "unsure", "no"]
          ),
          color = alt.Color("ai_can_be_conscious:N").title("Answer"))
    )
chart_total
```

# Free-text responses

```{python}
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

def show_free(col, title):
    vals = survey_submissions_df[col].dropna().str.strip()
    if vals.empty:
        display(Markdown(f"### {title}\n*(no responses yet)*"))
        return
    display(Markdown(f"### {title}\n"))
    for i, txt in enumerate(vals, 1):
        display(Markdown(f"**{i}.** {txt}\n"))

show_free("reasoning",             "Reasoning for the main question")
show_free("measure_consciousness", "Suggestions for measuring consciousness")
show_free("ai_rights",             "Views on rights for conscious AIs")
show_free("ai_declare_rights",     "Reactions to self-declared AI rights")
```
